### 1) What is on the screen
A broken left-column slice of graphics against a huge black void. Top left is a dark blue starfield with a black slab, then a lighter blue band, then a gap to black, then green blocky shapes with a white box containing truncated text, then a road with dashed white lines at bottom left. The eye goes first to the high-contrast white boxed text "BAS: / SOU'" in region x,y,w,h 116,608,100,124 measured from top left of the image. I cannot see what the player is being asked to do - no title, no press start, no player sprite, no readable objective.

### 2) Does it look like a real NES game
(a) PASS - 8 distinct colours, all verified as NES palette entries, well under the 25 colours on screen ceiling of 12 BG + 12 sprite + 1 backdrop, reads as NES.
(b) PASS - shading is flat, one colour per shape, dither is 1-bit checker, no gradient banding I can see.
(c) FAIL - no sprite reads at a glance; green blocks bleed into black with no silhouette, white dither blob at bottom right is unreadable.
(d) PASS - no anti-aliasing or soft edges; all edges are hard 4x blocks, including text and window borders.
(e) FAIL - background colour changes do not sit on the 16 x 16 pixel boundary; the vertical cut from graphics to black at ~x=408 file pixels = 102 NES pixels is mid-attribute, not on a 16-pixel grid. Measured numbers do not contradict this: 69.3% single-colour cover matches the black void I see.

### 3) Composition and text
Crowded into a left strip roughly x 0,0,412,960, empty on the right roughly x 412,0,612,960 which is solid black except for one blob. Focal point is the truncated text box, which is not where a player needs it - it is cut off and low in frame. Only legible text region is [116,608,100,124] reading "BAS: / SOU'". The worst - and only - text is that box: right edge cropped mid-glyph, so E and TH/H are missing, 8x8 glyph grid broken at the cut, illegible at 256x240 without guessing.

### 4) What looks AI generated or off
Not AI mush - looks handmade but broken capture / nametable setup. Honest failure, not a prompt render.
Tells named: massive 69% $0F black void reads as missing nametable, not design; left graphics slice ends in a straight vertical cut mid-tile; text box cropped mid-letter; road is occluded mid-tile by a flat green rectangle; isolated white-black checker comet in blackness with no ground or shadow; top black slab has stray grey single pixels with no tile structure. I cannot see pillow shading or modern gradients - none present.

### 5) Five concrete fixes
1. Right void region [408,0,616,960]: fill missing nametable, snap new vertical seam to x=384 file pixels = 96 NES pixels, which is 6x16, using existing BG palettes only, no new colours.
2. Text box region [116,608,100,124]: move whole 8x8-tile box left by 32 file pixels = 8 NES pixels and redraw two rows on the glyph grid in NES white $30 as "BASE" / "SOUTH", restore full 1-tile white border.
3. Top slab region [44,76,324,36]: delete stray grey pixels and replace black slab fringe with NES blue $21 sky, or delete object and redraw as two 8x16 sprites aligned to 32 file-pixel grid.
4. Green occluder region [204,760,208,148]: replace flat NES green $19 block with $0F backdrop/transparent to reveal road tiles, snap its left edge to x=192 file pixels = 48 NES pixels = 3x16.
5. Comet dither region [548,848,196,100]: delete checker dither or rebuild as proper sprite using sprite palette white $30 + NES grey $10, 8x16, no dither, and move by 64 file pixels = 16 NES pixels to sit on background grid if kept.

### 6) Scores and machine readable block
nes_authenticity: 5 - palette/tiles are NES-legal but frame is not shippable as a real NES screen.
readability: 2 - one cropped sign, no objective, 60% void.
charm: 2 - colours are honest but composition is a bug, no character.
